messages:
Lina: morning — quick brass-tacks async: what I did / blockers / today
Lina: did the kernel microbatch patch (PR #4821) — added a fast-path for 1-token hot loops, landed tests locally, pushed for CI
Lina: blocker: seeing a 7% p95 regression on short-chat workloads in canary, not sure if it's scheduling jitter or our new circular buffer math
Raj: saw that in the dashboards, p95 spike correlates with increased microbatch coalescing events around shard 7
Raj: can you post the flamegraph or a pprof snapshot?
Lina: here's a small trace (copied):
```
goroutine profile: total 1024
CPU profile: 30s
flat  flat%   sum%        cum   cum%
  120ms  0.40%  0.40%   310ms  1.03%  runtime.schedule
  80ms   0.27%  0.67%    80ms  0.27%  github.com/redwood/kernel/batcher.coalesce
```
Lina: small but noisy. suspect `coalesce` backpressure when slot steal happens
Tor: fwiw I reproduced with the local microbench; adding a small sleep between enqueues reduces coalesce contention — seems like a race in enqueue fast-path
Tor: opened https://git.redwood/eng/runtime/pulls/4830 with a mutex->atomic try-fix (WIP)
Morgan: re: KV cache, I ran the eviction heatmap job overnight. seeing hot key churn on a subset of users hitting prefix caching. eviction rate ~12% higher than baseline
Morgan: hypothesis: the new cache partitioning makes some prefixes mapped to a small set of shards — will run a rehash test tonight
Zoe: FYI I'm on review for PR #4821 and #4830 — left comments about a potential memory fence on the atomic path
Lina: thanks Zoe. I'll address the fence comment and add a microbench for the 1-token path
Raj: quick ask — can someone trigger a canary restart after Tor's patch merges? deploy-bot can do it but need manual approval from eng-runtime leads
deploy-bot: @eng-runtime canary-3 restart queued. waiting for approval from Lina or Raj
Lina: approving now. go ahead deploy-bot :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: restart started (canary-3). will post status when finished
Morgan: today I'll start the KV rehash experiment and wire the heatmap into the console dashboard so we can watch in realtime
Zoe: I'll finish the PR feedback and land the fence change; then run bench harness on p95 short-chat and long-context workloads
Tor: If the atomic fix doesn't fully remove jitter, next step is to add a lightweight per-shard backoff token. I'll prototype after lunch
Lina: final notes: if you hit the p95 regression locally, comment `repro: p95-coalesce` on the PR so CI picks the special test matrix
Raj: ack. ping me if you need extra GPU for long-run benches
Zoe: also logging small note — please avoid printing full request payloads in bench runs (we already trimmed a ton)
Lina: thanks team. short follow-ups only here today. :coffee:
